description: Source code for a file checking utility used in testing, based on LLVM's FileCheck, with additional integration for PyTorch JIT and source highlighting features.

classes.name: Check
classes.description: Represents a check command with type, search string, and optional count.

classes.name: FileCheckImpl
classes.description: Implementation class handling the core logic of parsing and executing file checks.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Outputs a Check object to a stream.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the check process on a given test file or graph.

methods.name: addCheck
methods.description: Adds a check command to the internal list.

methods.name: parseSingleCheck
methods.description: Parses a single check command from source text.

methods.name: findNextStart
methods.description: Finds the next line starting with a check command.

methods.name: parseStrings
methods.description: Parses all check commands from source text.

methods.name: doCheckNot
methods.description: Performs 'not' checks to ensure certain strings are absent.

methods.name: doCheckSourceHighlighted
methods.description: Verifies that a token is highlighted in source.

methods.name: matchDagGroup
methods.description: Matches a group of checks in DAG order.

methods.name: matchGroup
methods.description: Matches a group of checks in sequence.

methods.name: doChecks
methods.description: Performs all checks on the source.
